propositions: infer_provider('gemini-*') returns 'google_genai', which is not a member of _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or ProviderSession._builders, causing provider construction to fail at runtime
bare gemini-* model ids fail at call time (not config time) when routed through model_classes._resolve_target, producing an unresolvable provider string
_PROVIDER_PREFIXES mapping gemini -> google_genai contradicts pydantic-ai's canonical provider names and causes ProviderSession.is_resolvable() to reject the inferred provider
mapping gemini to google (pydantic-ai's current canonical Gemini Developer API name) would make bare gemini-* ids resolvable and consistent with both KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES and pydantic-ai's registry
anthropic_model._PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX contains a google_genai -> google-gla back-compat shim that would remain valid after the fix as an explicit model_provider override
